title: Zesty Romantic Tunisian Cheese Tagine
description: A mustardy and snappy Tunisian dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, perfect for a romantic evening, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients and a touch of sweetness from candy

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: such as dates or dried apricots

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the shredded cheese and chopped candy, stirring until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, and accompanied by whole wheat bread
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together
